_why: counterfactual probe 12 Sep: 10/10 wrapped x2 and lean; qwen2.5:3b 0/9

wrapper_moved_between_the_two_wrapped_ru.why_it_matters: the same term flipped 3 of 9 of cortex-l1-3b's verdicts at temperature 0; L1b returned identical verdicts on all ten

_detail.case_set_note: the L1b runs are n=10; the earlier comparisons are n=9. target:MATERIALS_WASTE_REVIEW gained a usable counterfactual in between, so 10/10 is not strictly like-for-like with 9/9 — L1b got all ten, including the nine the others were asked.
_detail.NAME_IS_EXPLICIT_ON_PURPOSE: The model is NOT renamed to cortex-l1b:3b. brain._fast_model() picks the smallest installed model by a regex that reads the digits after a COLON in the name, so a tag like 'cortex-l1b:3b' would score 3.0 and silently become the answer for EVERY fast=True call in the system. Here a role is chosen by name, in a config, for one named caller. A quiet global effect is exactly what this file exists to avoid.
